6A.

6B.

Staff Report
6C.
City Clerk – Appoint Members to Fill Commission Vacancies on Commission on Aging, Environmental Quality and Energy Conservation Commission, and Historic Preservation Commission. Expenditure: None.
Staff Report
6D.
Torrance Theatre Company’s 2025 Season Kick-Off in Downtown Torrance.
7.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
#1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comments on items under the Consent Calendar or items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..
8A.
City Clerk – Approve City Council Minutes. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Clerk that City Council approve the City Council minutes of August 12, 2025.
Staff Report
8B.
SECOND AND FINAL READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 3952 and Determination that the Ordinance is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). Expenditure: None.
Second and Final Reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3952 amending Section 415.1.040(b) "Operating Standards" and repealing Section 415.1.050 "Pilot Program" of Division 4 "Public Health and Welfare", Chapter 15 "Cottage Food" of the Torrance Municipal Code and approval of the Ordinance Summary for publication. Additionally, the City Council finds and determines that the Ordinance is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Sections 15378 and 15061(b)(3) of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations as described in Section 6 of the Ordinance. This item is for consideration of adoption of the ordinance only. The item was previously discussed, and action was taken at a prior council meeting.
Staff Report
8C.
SECOND AND FINAL READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 3955
Second and Final Reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3955 amending Chapter 1, Article 3 of Division 9 of the Torrance Municipal Code by adding a new Section 91.3.4 pertaining to target residential density and approval of the Ordinance Summary for publication. This item is for consideration of adoption of the ordinance only. The item was previously discussed, and action was taken at a prior council meeting.
Staff Report
8D.
SECOND AND FINAL READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 3957
Second and Final Reading of ORDINANCE NO. 3957 amending Chapter 1, 2, 3, 9, 12 and 13 of Division 8 of the Torrance Municipal Code to adopt and amend the 2025 edition of the California Building Code Volumes 1 and 2 with appendices, the 2025 edition of the California Electrical Code, the 2025 edition of the California Plumbing Code with appendices, the 2025 edition of the California Mechanical Code with appendices, the 2025 edition of the California Residential Code with appendices, and the 2025 edition of the California Green Building Standards Code and approval of the Ordinance Summary for publication. This item is for consideration of adoption of the ordinance only. The item was previously discussed, and action was taken at a prior council meeting.
Staff Report
8E.
Fire – Ratify Fiscal Year 2024 Urban Area Security Initiative (UASI) Grant Program Subrecipient Agreement. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Fire Chief that City Council ratify the Fiscal Year 2024 Urban Area Security Initiative (UASI) Grant Program Subrecipient Agreement approved on August 19, 2025.
Staff Report
8F.
Traffic Commission and Public Works – Accept and File 2024-25 Traffic Commission Annual Report. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Traffic Commission and Public Works Director that City Council accept and file the 2024-25 Traffic Commission Annual Report.
Staff Report
8G.
City Treasurer – Approve Amendment and Adopt RESOLUTION Approving Amendment to 401(a) Defined Contribution Plan for Fire Plan 98215-03. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Treasurer that City Council approve an amendment and adopt a RESOLUTION approving an amendment to the 401(a) Defined Contribution Plan for Fire Plan 98215-03 to allow participant Roth contributions effective October 7, 2025.
Staff Report
8H.
City Treasurer – Accept and File Investment Report for the Month of July 2025. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Treasurer that City Council accept and file the Investment Report for the month of July 2025.
Staff Report
8I.
Finance - Adopt RESOLUTION Amending Resolution No. 2023-11 Section 2(3) Relating to Compensation of Measure SST Citizens' Oversight Committee Members. Expenditure: $210 (General Fund).
Recommendation of the Finance Director that City Council adopt a RESOLUTION amending Resolution No. 2023-11 Section 2(3) titled "Composition, Compensation, and Qualifications" relating to compensation of Measure SST Citizens' Oversight Committee members.
Staff Report
8J.
Transit – Approve Submission of the Transit Department’s Annual Public Transportation Agency Safety Plan. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Transit Director that City Council approve the submission of the Transit Department’s Annual Public Transportation Agency Safety Plan as required by the Federal Transit Administration.
Staff Report
9.
HEARINGS – None Scheduled.
10.
ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS
10A.
Finance – Adopt ORDINANCE Amending Torrance Municipal Code (TMC) to Establish Administrative Remedies Procedure for Challenges to Property-Related Fees, Charges, and Assessments. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Finance Director that City Council:
1.
Adopt an ORDINANCE amending the Torrance Municipal Code to establish an administrative remedies procedure for challenges to city-imposed fees, charges, and assessments on real property; and
2.
Approve an Ordinance Summary for publication.
Staff Report
10B.
Fire – Set Date of October 21, 2025 for a Public Hearing on the Proposed Local Amendments to the 2025 California Fire Code. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Fire Chief that City Council set a date of October 21, 2025 for a public hearing on the proposed local amendments to the 2025 California Fire Code.
Staff Report
10C.
Fire – Accept and File Update on the Public Access Defibrillator (PAD) Program. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Fire Chief that City Council accept and file an update on the Public Access Defibrillator (PAD) Program.
Staff Report
10D.
City Manager – Accept and File Economic Development Update and Consider and Provide Direction on Proposed Economic Development Initiatives. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council:
1.
Accept and file the Economic Development update; and
2.
Consider and provide direction on proposed Economic Development initiatives.
Staff Report
10E.
City Manager and City Attorney - Reconsideration of a Council Action to Deny an Appeal and Uphold a Planning Commission's Approval of a Conditional Use Permit (CUP24-00028) and Development Permit (DVP24-00004) on Property Located within the Hawthorne Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan - Del Amo Business Sub District Two (H-DA2 Zone) at 3475 Torrance Boulevard (APN 7524-014-110). Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the City Manager and the City Attorney that the City Council consider a motion to reconsider a Council Action to Deny an Appeal and Uphold a Planning Commission's Approval of a Conditional Use Permit (CUP24-00028) and Development Permit (DVP24-00004) on property located within the Hawthorne Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan - Del Amo Business Sub-District Two (H-DA2 Zone) at 3475 Torrance Boulevard (APN 7524-014-110). It is further recommended that in the event the City Council decides to reconsider their prior Council action, that the matter be brought back to the City Council at a future date.
Staff Report
10F.
Community Services — Accept and File Coyote Management Plan Update and Provide Direction on Continuing Coyote Abatement Services. Expenditure: None.
Recommendation of the Community Services Director that City Council:
1.
Accept and file the Coyote Management Plan update; and
2.
Provide direction on continuing coyote abatement services.
Staff Report
11.
AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled.
RECESS
RECONVENE

#2 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comments on items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
14.
ADJOURNMENT
Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, October 07, 2025, at 5:00 p.m. for closed session with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the LeRoy J. Jackson Council Chamber.
Tuesday, September 30, 2025 is a City Council Dark Night.
